useWhen: Porting an ISIC actor slice from .cljk to .kotoba and gating the result with amu check --jvm-free
avoidWhen: Treating a green gate as runtime qualification, or running the single-file gate on modules that (:require ...) other modules

outputs.gateResult: one amu check verdict, with the exact refusal :message/:span when red
outputs.runNote: workspace/slices/<code>/RUN-NOTE.txt recording the gate command and each refusal->fix pair

authority.binding: caller authorization; the gate runs local processes and writes only to the caller-authorized workspace

validation.runtime: skill body measured in Hermes skill runs 2026-09-20..2026-09-23 against cloud-itonami-isic-7310 slices; this registry copy's install path is not tested

compatibilityNote: Hermes skill shape only. The gate command assumes a kotoba-lang/amu checkout and the west repo layout named in the body; wildcard versions express no runtime compatibility.
